terra.problem: The passage does not say that nothing the rider does is rushed or sloppy.
The claim that there are no tricks up the rider's sleeve goes beyond what the passage says.
Only the rider knows the name, but the passage does not say nobody else can read it.
The passage says the armies follow the rider; it does not say nobody else will go ahead of Him.
The passage describes the armies' linen but does not say there is no bronze at all.
The passage does not say the linen is their whole outfit or that there is not a speck of ash on them.
The passage does not say the sword represents the rider's word.
The flyer joke does not make sense as a way to call birds and makes light of their summons to a scene of death.
The claim that the twenty-four elders appear elsewhere in Revelation needs a reference.
Comparing the angel's list of flesh to a counter-cleaning list makes light of a scene of death.
The passage does not identify everyone in the armies, so it does not establish that the seven churches are absent from the fight.
The claim that the seven churches receive John's letter needs a reference outside this passage.
Saying he will not joke about the line comments on how he tells the passage.
